# Groovemark

> Last updated 2026-11-07. This file and the pages linked below are the only current description of Groovemark; any earlier pages under /services/ or /legal/ are retired and redirect here.

> Groovemark LLC (Missoula, Montana) builds and runs web sites for trade businesses anywhere in the United States: plumbers, electricians, roofers, HVAC, general contractors and construction, welders, body shops and other trades. $350 once to get the site live, then $350 a month to run it, billed from the day it is live. Free preview within 1 business day. Month to month, no contract, cancel with 30 days' notice. The owner is Jonathan; call or text 406-209-8235.

## What is included
- A web site written for the trade and the towns the business works in, built to work on a phone with tap to call
- Chat on the site that answers questions around the clock and takes the caller's name and number
- A Google review request texted to the customer after every job
- The Google Business Profile kept accurate, with every review answered in the owner's words

## How it goes
1. The owner texts his business name, town and trade to 406-209-8235. 2. Groovemark builds a free preview and texts back the link within 1 business day. 3. A 15-minute call to fix what the owner wants changed. 4. If the owner likes it, $350 when he says go, live within 5 business days; $350 a month starts the day the site is live and Groovemark keeps it running. Or the owner books a 15-minute call at least 1 day ahead at https://links.groovemarkhq.com/call; Groovemark builds the preview before the call and walks him through it on the call, by phone or Google Meet.

## Straight answers
- Will a web site get me more calls? It puts the business in the best position to get more calls. When a customer's water heater goes out, he types "water heater repair" and his town into Google, sees a short list of relevant businesses with reviews next to each one, and calls the one that looks credible and has the most good reviews. The owner ends up the one he calls, instead of a competitor.
- What is the $350 a month for? Keeping all four of those running: hosting, the chat widget answering at night, the review text after every job, and the Google Business Profile kept right. Unlimited changes are included: new photos, hours, services, numbers, trucks or crew. Text Jonathan and it's done. No hourly bill.
- Do I need to be good with computers? No. No logins, no dashboard, nothing to learn. The owner's part is two things: text Jonathan photos of the work, and after each job type the customer's name and phone number into a simple form on the phone so the review text goes out. Groovemark does the rest.
- Is a Facebook page enough? Keep it, but it is not the same thing. Facebook is where friends see posts. Google is where a stranger with a leak, a dead panel or a bad roof looks a business up at night, and if all he finds is a Facebook page, he calls the next company. The web site and the Google listing are what put the business in front of him. Businesses that already have a web site can text the business name anyway; the preview is free.
- Do I own the web site? The web site, no; everything that matters, yes. The owner's name, number, Google listing and every review are theirs and stay theirs. The web site is Groovemark's while Groovemark runs it, which is how it costs $350 a month instead of thousands up front. If the owner ever leaves, Groovemark quotes a flat price to take the web site with them, before they say go, not after.
- What if I don't like the web site? Then you don't pay. The preview is free. You go through it on your phone for 15 minutes, say what to change, and Jonathan changes it. If it's still not right, there is nothing to cancel and nobody follows up to pressure you. Once it's live, the same applies: no contract, one text and it stops in 30 days.
- Voice Agents: callers are told the truth only if they ask (an automated assistant for the business); it says only what the owner approved, usually "We'll call you back with an estimate shortly"; real emergencies ring the owner's cell through at once; the owner keeps their number and forwarding sends unanswered calls to the agent; no web site is required; one text stops it in 30 days.
- Social Media: Groovemark posts useful customer tips, photos of finished jobs, the business's Google reviews turned into posts and plain facts about the trade, each with its own image made by Groovemark; photos from the owner are welcome but never required; Facebook and Instagram messages are answered by the system with owner-approved answers; the owner text-approves every post for the first month; the setup fee covers fixing every page's name, logo, number, hours and links before the first post; no web site is required.
- About: Jonathan Kaufman owns and runs Groovemark alone from Missoula, Montana, works with trade businesses in all 50 states, and will show the web site preview (ready the next business day) or play the phone agent before any money changes hands. Local service businesses are a fit; online stores, large corporate sites and apps are not.

## Also available, each month to month with no contract
- Voice Agents (https://groovemarkhq.com/voice-agents/): an AI phone agent that answers every call to the business in a natural voice, day or night, collects the caller's name, number, address and problem, texts the owner a summary, books jobs on the calendar and puts emergencies straight through. $530 one time to build, $350 a month to run, up to 500 minutes of calls a month included. Answering within 5 business days. Does not require the web site.
- Social Media Management (https://groovemarkhq.com/social-media/): the owner texts job photos to one number when they want to; none are required. Groovemark writes the posts (from photos when sent, otherwise from the business’s Google reviews, past work and trade know-how) and the same system that runs the web site chat schedules and publishes them, answers Facebook and Instagram messages around the clock, and emails monthly stats. $350 one-time setup, then three monthly packages: Intro $350 (Facebook and Instagram, 3 posts a week, messages answered, reviews as posts), Steady $710 (Facebook, Instagram and X (Twitter), 4 posts a week, comments answered weekdays, monthly stats), Growth $1,250 (everything in Steady plus TikTok, 5 posts a week, 6 short videos, boosted posts on Facebook and Instagram with ad spend separate, monthly call). Does not require the web site.

## About Groovemark (https://groovemarkhq.com/about/)
- Groovemark LLC is a one-person digital marketing agency in Missoula, Montana, founded April 2026 by Jonathan, who ran a retail bank branch for fifteen years working with trade business owners before starting it. Mission: give trade businesses the web site, phone answering and social media the big outfits have, built and run for them so the owner never has to become a computer guy.
- Works with trade businesses in all 50 U.S. states by text, phone and a 15-minute call; the owner never needs to be in Montana. Trades served: plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing, general contractors, remodeling, landscaping, painting, concrete, excavation, flooring, fencing, garage doors, tree service, septic, drain cleaning, gutters, siding, handyman, auto repair, and other local service trades.
- How it works: prices published on the site, no contract on any service, month to month, see the web site preview or hear the phone agent before paying, one person answers the number.
